title: Daily Routine

story.title: A day in Bobur’s life
story.text: Bobur is a student in Tashkent, and he also works part-time in a café. His days are very busy! | He **always** **wakes up** at half past six, but he doesn’t **get up** immediately – he checks his phone first. Then he **has a shower**, **gets dressed** and **has breakfast** with his mum. He **brushes his teeth** and **leaves home** at half past seven to **catch the bus**. | His classes **start** at eight. At twelve he **has lunch** with his friends, and in the afternoon he goes to the café. He **usually** **starts work** at two and **finishes work** at six. He can **take a break** for fifteen minutes. | When he **gets home**, he **often** helps his mum. Sometimes he **cooks dinner**, and he **does the housework** **twice a week**. He **hardly ever** watches TV. | Bobur **never** **goes to bed** before midnight – he studies in the evening. He’s tired, but he loves his life!

answers: Are you a morning person or a night owl?
I’m definitely **a night owl**. I **hardly ever** go to bed before midnight because I like studying when it’s quiet.
What is your favourite part of the day? Why?
**My favourite part of the day is** the evening. I **get home**, have dinner with my family and relax. **For example**, we often drink tea and talk.
speech: Hello everyone! Let me tell you about my daily routine. **On weekdays I usually** get up at seven o’clock. **The first thing I do is** drink a glass of water. **After that**, I have a shower, get dressed and have breakfast. **It takes me about** twenty **minutes to** get to school by bus. I have lunch at one and finish school at three. **In the evening I like to** play football or read. I **hardly ever** watch TV. **At the weekend my routine is different** – I get up late and visit my grandparents. Thank you!
